digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and pytest test selection
propositions: Nineteen repository-policy assertions that inspect only immutable repository text and AST are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite being OS/Python-invariant

The shared workflow applies an identical default marker expression to all matrix cells, causing OS-invariant policy tests to run on macOS unnecessarily and extend critical path time by approximately 8 seconds per run

Repository-policy nodes must be marked with a strict pytest marker and routed to execute exactly once in the Ubuntu 3.13 default-suite process while being excluded from the other three default selections via `and not repo_policy`
Seven mixed test modules contain both invariant policy assertions and runtime/subprocess behavior tests that must remain unmarked and cross-platform to preserve platform-compatibility coverage
The workflow must preserve exactly two pytest sessions, the integration selector unchanged, and all four default/integration matrix cells without adding new jobs or runners
